chunks: About eating together with a Jew or a Christian, so he said: "There is no harm if it is from your food."
And he asked him about eating together with a Magian, so he said: "If he performs wudu (ablution), then there is no harm."

key_terms.مُؤَاكَلَةِ: eating together or sharing a meal

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on eating together with Jews, Christians, and Magians in this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on eating with non-Muslims. It permits eating with a Jew or Christian when the food is one's own, and with a Magian when he has performed wudu (ablution).

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.4222 - And Al-'Ays ibn Al-Qasim asked Imam (as): "Regarding eating with a Jew or a Christian?"
Imam (as) said: "There is no harm if it is from your food."

And he asked Imam (as) about eating with a Magian.
Imam (as) said: "If he performs ablution, then there is no harm."
